subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: From his childhood, onesty and morality were his darling attributes.
From his childhood, honesty and morality were his darling atributes.
From his childhood, honesty and morality were his darling attributes.
From his childhood, honesty and morallity were his darling attributes.

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"honesty"** means the quality of being truthful and sincere. (ईमानदारी)

 
 
• **Example:** His **honesty** earned him the respect of his peers.
 
 
 
• **"Morality"** refers to principles concerning the distinction between right and wrong or good and bad behavior. (नैतिकता)
 
 
• **Example:** **Morality** often guides us to make ethical decisions.
 
 

Therefore, the correct sentence having no spelling error is** "From his childhood, honesty and morality were his darling attributes.."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** **"Onesty**" is a misspelling o**f "honesty". **(ईमानदारी)

 
 
• **Example:** The word should be "**honesty"**, not "onesty".
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** **"Atributes"** is a misspelling of **"attributes**". (गुण)
 
 
• **Example:** The word should be "**attributes**", not "atributes".
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "**Morallity"** is a misspelling of** "morality"**. (नैतिकता)
 
 
• **Example:** The word should be **"morality"**, not "morallity".
 
 

37:Td05,

The correct answer is Option 4)&
